scope: Togo medical discovery — Université de Lomé Faculty of Health Sciences

verifiedFacts.claim: Université de Lomé's official Faculty of Health Sciences page identifies a seven-year State Doctorate in Medicine and says the faculty trains doctors, pharmacists and medical specialists.
The faculty states that students undertake placements under agreements with university hospitals, regional hospitals, district hospitals and prefecture hospitals.
A 2025/26 FSS call for applications set a dossier review fee of CFA 10,000 for Togolese/UEMOA applicants and CFA 15,000 for applicants outside UEMOA, with a September 2025 submission window.
Togo's official 2025/26 recognised-institutions announcement lists Université de Lomé among the country's public universities.

holdReasons: No current Medicine tuition or mandatory-fee schedule was found; the published dossier-review fee is not programme tuition.
The reviewed call is for 2025/26, not a confirmed active 2026/27 Medicine intake, and does not establish the complete programme-level entry route.
Current teaching-language confirmation, named clinical partners, accommodation, scholarship/loan support and professional-registration pathway were not established from reviewed primary sources.
nextAction: Obtain the active Medicine prospectus/admissions notice and fee decision, then verify language, named clinical sites, support arrangements and graduate-registration route before preparing a payload.
